title: Marguerite and the Choir
author: Zephyrine Vasquez
blurb: Ines Almeida, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
